result.instructions: Tools for Dixa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations mention a refund, and who is assigned to them?"; "Show me the messages in conversation 12345 and any internal notes."; "Which agents are online right now, and which queues are they in?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dixa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dixa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dixa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dixa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dixa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dixa_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the Dixa organization name, subdomain and details. Good first call to confirm the token works. Dixa API: GET /v1/organization.

tools.name: dixa_search_conversations
tools.title: Search conversations
tools.description: Full-text search over conversations (subjects and message text), with highlights. Returns conversation ids for the other conversation tools. Dixa API: GET /v1/search/conversations.

exact_match.description: true = match the exact phrase only.

page_key.description: Page key from the meta.next link of the previous page.

tools.name: dixa_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id, including its channel and requester. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_messages
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: List all messages of a conversation, in order (customer and agent messages). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_notes
tools.title: List internal notes
tools.description: List the internal notes of a conversation (visible to agents only). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/notes.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_tags
tools.title: List conversation tags
tools.description: List the tags on one conversation. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_ratings
tools.title: List conversation ratings
tools.description: List the latest rating (CSAT/NPS/thumbs) status of a conversation, per survey question. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/ratings.

tools.name: dixa_get_conversation_activity
tools.title: Get conversation activity log
tools.description: Get the activity log of one conversation (assignments, status changes, tags). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/activitylog.

tools.name: dixa_list_flows
tools.title: List conversation flows
tools.description: List the conversation flows, optionally for one channel. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/flows.

tools.name: dixa_add_internal_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a conversation. Internal notes are not sent to the customer. Dixa API: POST /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/notes.

agent_id.description: Agent (UUID) to write the note as. Omit for the System User.

tools.name: dixa_close_conversation
tools.title: Close conversation
tools.description: Close a conversation by id. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/close.

user_id.description: Agent (UUID) who closes it. Omit for the System User.

tools.name: dixa_reopen_conversation
tools.title: Reopen conversation
tools.description: Reopen a closed conversation. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/reopen.

user_id.description: Agent (UUID) who reopens it. Omit for the System User.

tools.name: dixa_tag_conversation
tools.title: Tag conversation
tools.description: Add an active tag to a conversation. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: dixa_untag_conversation
tools.title: Untag conversation
tools.description: Remove a tag from a conversation. Dixa API: DELETE /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags/{tagId}.
